line: Oh, then you do know it. (pause) So um what kind of things do you write about?

title: The One With The Rumor
line: All right! Okay, it's just Phoebe. Will's still on a diet, Chandler doesn't eat Thanksgiving food, and Rachel's having her aversion to poultry.

title: The One With the Lesbian Wedding
line: They want me to do it, which is really cool, seeing as I've never catered before, and I really need the money, and this isn't a problem for you, is it?

title: The One With Barry and Mindy's Wedding
line: So, I read this article in the paper the other day that says you're not supposed to throw rice at weddings, because when pigeons eat rice it kills them.

title: Friends TV Show The One With Christmas In Tulsa
line: Okay, Ben, why don't you come open some more presents. And Santa, the Armadillo, and I have a little talk in the kitchen? There's a sentence I'd never thought I'd say.

title: The One Where Chandler Can't Remember Which Sister
line: You know if it's any consolation, he really did sound like he was having more fun with you. (Rachel nods in agreement)

title: The One With The Girl From Poughkeepsie
line: They baked it. I can't take this anymore. I'm gonna call a meeting tonight, I'm gonna fire you tonight.

title: The One With The Proposal, Parts 1 and 2
line: Oh, what are you doing to me?! Oh look, I-I... I'm sorry but umm, this-this-this-this is not going to happen.

title: The One With Phoebe's Husband
line: I can't believe you're dressing up for him. I mean, you're just, you're setting yourself up all over again.

title: The One After "I Do"
line: ...in this day and age how dumb do you have to be to get pregnant?

title: The One With The Stain
line: Oh well umm, I make it myself! It's two parts ammonia and one part lemon juice. And now the secret ingredient is...you know what? We just met.

title: The One Where Joey Dates Rachel
line: Okay, I got that. I'll escape over there. I'll come back over here. All right, come on Ms. Pac-Man . It's got...Right...(She dies.) Well, you're just a little bitch, aren't you?

title: The One With The Baby Shower
line: That's right! Maybe it's time you took a good hard look at a mirror young lady...old lady...lady!

title: The One With the Two Bullies
line: I wanna buy 5 shares of SGJ and I wanna buy them now. C'mon time is money my friend. Thank you. Wooo.

title: The One With The Girl Who Hits Joey
line: You don't know everything. Did you know that I'm going out with Rachel tonight instead of you? Hmm? And did you know that the only baby around here is you?! And did you know that I can't even look at you right now?! (She storms out.)

title: The One With Rachel's Date
line: Coming right up Monica. I have to do everything you say otherwise the system breaks down. I know that, then why are we having this conversation?

title: The One Where Phoebe Hates PBS
line: Yes. Yes, I was. A guy. From work. (Thinks) I'm seeing a guy from work! Ha!

title: The One With Joey's New Brain
line: No, there is no way! It can not be Ross! (She looks through the window and sees Ross practicing and fumbling around with the pipes.) Unbelievable! Why is your family Scottish?!

title: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
line: Rachel, what's going on? I mean isn't this the same Barry who you left at the altar?

title: The One Where Ross Moves In
line: I think so. Se, he-he's not inviting you to his party because he likes you.

title: The One With Two Parts
line: (as Rachel) Yeah... Yeah, I know it's pretty selfish, but haha, hey, that's me. (Indicating a dish on the table) Why don't you try the hummus?

title: The One With The Embryos
line: I got it! How about, if we win, they have to get rid of the rooster?

title: The One With The Soap Opera Party
line: Oh, man! If I had known I was coming to this party I never would have gotten married!

title: The One With the Chicken Pox
line: Alright, you see these little flower blossoms? They should be facing up, not down, because, well, the head of the bed is where the sun would be. You don't love me any more do you.

title: The One With The Rumor
line: You wanna meet some people? This is uh; this is my husband Chandler. Chandler, this is Will.

title: The One With Chandler's Work Laugh
line: Great! Umm, well what-what I was doing in Chandler's room is that umm, I was cleaning it! In fact, he pays me to clean it!

title: The One With The Football
line: You're so pathetic! Why can't you just accept it, we're winning because I'm better than you.

title: The One With The Lottery
line: No, no! We should divide them up (picks up the bowl) and I should get extra because we used my car to buy them!

title: The One After Vegas
line: Wait a minute. That wasn't a hard eight! Last night I rolled a hard eight.

title: Friends TV Show The One With The Birth Mother
line: Yeah, but the important thing to know about us is how much we would care for this little baby. (holds up the sonogram)

title: The One With Rachel's New Dress
line: Oh, sure it does! In high school, you weren't jealous at all even though all your girlfriends were cheating on you!

title: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
line: (looking out of the window) Oh my God. You guys! You gotta come see this! There's some creep out there with a telescope!

title: Friends TV Show The One With The Home Study
line: Crazy Generous! I'm sorry. It's just-- I can't imagine giving up my one wedding day like that!

title: The One With the Two Parties
line: Could you guys please try to keep it down, we're trying to start a Boggle tournament.

title: The One With Phoebe's Birthday Dinner
line: Oh, sure, now you're Mister Sensitivity. But when you wanted to have sex right after my uncle's funeral...

title: The One With Chandler's Dad
line: I still say that if we had called your dad we coulda gotten better seats.

title: The One With the Baby on the Bus
line: Who da wenny-Benny boy? You the Wenny-wenny-Benny-Benny boy, yes. (Ben starts crying.) Don't cry. Don't cry. (To Ross) Why is he still crying?

title: The One Where Rachel Has A Baby, Parts 1 and 2
line: Yeah but I was just screwing with you to try to get your voice all high and weird like mine is now!

title: The One With The Football
line: All right, we still have a minute and a half to go, and we're down by two points. Two points.... (she gets interrupted by the guys, who are doing a slow-motion high five.) Phoebe you do a button-hook again. Rachel, you go long.

title: The One With The Ball
line: Guys, could you please just stop throwing the ball for one minute and just help me find it!

title: The One With All the Kips
line: We know. Please? Please?! We just don't want to deal with telling everyone, okay? Just promise you won't tell.

title: The One With Joey's Award
line: So I'm not supposed to share my doubts and fears with the guy I'm gonna spend the rest of my life with?

title: The One With Ross's Teeth
line: Okay. Oh but Joey, come over later because I'm going to teach you to make a bird feeder out of just a pine cone and some peanut butter.

title: The One With The Metaphorical Tunnel
line: Oh wait, you know what, I got it, I got it, pretend like you just woke up, okay, that will throw her off. Be sleepy.

title: The One With Joey's New Brain
line: (entering with Rachel) Oh my God! It's true!! Oh my God you are so amazing! Oh my God, can I just ask you to do me oh, just one favor?

title: The One With The Rumor
line: Hey guys this stuff is just so way in the past. You-you've been through so much since then. And right now you've got so much more important stuff going on in your life. Can't you just let this go?
